caption: A magnet is swept over a mix of nails and plastic beads spilled on the floor, and the nails stick to the magnet while the beads stay behind.

sa.check: Nails and plastic beads spilled together on a floor.
A magnet is swept over the mix.
The nails stick to the magnet.
The beads stay behind on the floor.
The beads are plastic: coloured, round, not metallic.
The sweep comes first and the nails lift as it passes.

pc.expect: As the magnet passes close over the mix, nails beneath it jump up and cling to it; the beads do not move toward the magnet.
pc.fail: The magnet passes close over nails and they stay on the floor; or beads jump up and cling to the magnet; or nails rise beside the magnet without touching it; or nails stick to the magnet while it is still high above them.

pc.expect: The nails on the magnet are nails from the floor; nails and beads keep their number and kind; the beads left behind are the beads that were there.
pc.fail: Nails multiply on the magnet; or nails vanish in mid-air; or a bead turns into a nail or a nail into a bead; or beads vanish as the magnet passes.

pc.expect: The nails hang from the magnet in contact with it; any that drop fall back to the floor; the beads lie where they were.
pc.fail: Nails hang in the air below the magnet without touching it; or a nail that comes off drifts sideways or upward; or beads float; or the nails stand upright above the magnet.

pc.expect: Beads move only if nudged by the magnet or a nail; nothing else on the floor stirs; nails on the magnet stay put.
pc.fail: Beads roll toward or away from the magnet with nothing touching them; or nails on the magnet crawl about; or the mix rearranges away from the magnet's path.

pc.expect: Nails and beads stay outside the magnet's body and above the floor; the magnet passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A nail sinks into the magnet; or the magnet passes through the floor; or nails pass through beads; or the magnet merges with the nails into one lump.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour, the beads' colours and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or the beads change colour; or the floor pattern changes.
